blocks.text: Macule: flat change in skin with a color change (brown, blue, red, or hypopigmented)

items: Nodule: solid lesion >0.5–2.0 cm (nodule >2.0 cm is a tumor)
Papule: raised, solid lesion ≤0.5 cm; varies in color
Vesicle: ≤0.5 cm elevated lesion that contains fluid
Wheal (hive): transient rounded or flat-top plaque

blocks.text: Chapter 14  Dermatology | That’s Enough Bugs for Now!

items: THAT’S ENOUGH BUGS FOR NOW! NOTES
Topical steroids work by causing vasoconstriction.

blocks.text: $ Potency: amount of drug needed to produce effect; affected by the amount of
vasoconstriction produced, immunosuppressive effects, and the vehicle used

items: $ Vehicle: medium that contains the medicine

blocks.text: Ointment Works well in thick or hyperkeratotic lesions; avoid in hairy areas
Cream Less residue, dries quickly; use in skinfolds and acute inflammation

items: Lotion Works well in hairy areas; less occlusive, dries quickly
Gel Works in hairy areas, especially scalp (nongreasy)
Foam Ideal for scalps, but expensive
